prepare_anthropic_messages: prepare a list of Anthropic API messages from user text content for Claude
prepare_anthropic_vision_messages: prepare Anthropic vision messages with optional prefix, suffix, and resized base64 encoded images
call_anthropic_api: call the Anthropic Claude API with messages, model, max tokens, and temperature settings
call_anthropic_api_with_retry: call the Anthropic API with automatic retry using exponential backoff up to 6 attempts
run_anthropic_cli: run the module directly to send a message to Claude and print the response
